verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Knowledge as a framework feature that agents use through tools, with scopes passed per run by a server. Nothing documents running it headlessly, in CI pipelines, or through a non-interactive automation entry point. The only operational instruction is `mastra dev` plus the Studio UI, which is interactive, so programmatic agent use is adjacent at best and not the headless/CI capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
